drugs.name: Levetiracetam
drugs.mechanism: Selectively binds synaptic vesicle protein 2A (SV2A) to inhibit presynaptic neurotransmitter exocytosis
drugs.efficacy: First-line broad-spectrum antiseizure medication for focal and generalized seizures

drugs.name: Cenobamate
drugs.mechanism: Dual-action preferential blocker of persistent sodium currents and positive allosteric modulator of GABAA receptors
drugs.efficacy: Unprecedented seizure freedom rates in treatment-resistant focal onset epilepsy
drugs.adverse_effects: Somnolence, dizziness, diplopia, fatigue, DRESS syndrome if escalated rapidly

drugs.name: Lacosamide
drugs.mechanism: Selectively enhances slow inactivation of voltage-gated sodium channels without affecting fast inactivation
drugs.efficacy: High efficacy and linear pharmacokinetics for focal-onset seizures
drugs.adverse_effects: Dizziness, headache, nausea, diplopia, PR interval prolongation

drugs.name: Lamotrigine
drugs.mechanism: Use-dependent blocker of voltage-gated sodium channels reducing rapid firing and glutamate release
drugs.efficacy: First-line monotherapy for focal and primary generalized tonic-clonic seizures
